name: Palette Amura Hotel - Near Gigamall
detail: I visited twice; the first time was great. The second time I went back, there was a staff member in the afternoon shift, and I wasn't very happy with their attitude. During my second stay, the water heater in the room didn't work in the evening; I waited quite a while for hot water but didn’t get any. If possible, I recommend everyone book the deluxe room, I find it better, and the prices on the app are better than booking directly outside. Don't be like me, asking questions and then booking through the app, which made the staff’s attitude change. The staff member working the night shift was very good and enthusiastic.
area: Thủ Đức,Ho Chi Minh City - View on map

name: Collection O Southern Star Hotel
detail: Очень хороший для своей цены отель! Путешествовал с другом, у нас было два номера одного типа. Все работало, санузел превосходный, были холодильники, два типа вентиляции: кондей и большой вентилятор на потолке. Большое количество вешалок в гардеробе при входе. ТВ. С вайфаем никаких проблем - это, похоже, вообще фича Вьетнама! У нас в номерах не было окон, но это особенность, а не недостаток. Персонал - обычный. Написано, что знает английский - не знает. За это 4 балла. Важно - несмотря на то, что на карте это место выглядит как центр - это переферия! Да нормального центра - 25 минут на мототакси или обычном такси. Поэтому - 3 за локацию. Но Grab работает превосходно: вызвать и доехать никаких проблем. Были проездом, поэтому возможно, я упустил какие-то плюсы. Просто совет: такси только! по приложению! Никаких свободных грабберов на улицах, которые подъезжают и предлагают так же или дешевле.

name: Belvilla in District 8 Near Ben Thanh Market Formerly Eva Hotel
detail: There is a room without a window. People might be picky about it, but the staff were kind. I was feeling down from the heat, so they allowed me an early check-in. They also greeted me with smiles many times. For 1100 yen, I have no complaints about this level of service.
area: District 8,Ho Chi Minh City - View on map

name: Bay Hotel Ho Chi Minh
detail: Above all, I really liked the location. As a traveler, everything worth visiting was accessible by foot, and the cleanliness of the accommodation was well maintained. Especially, the breakfast was excellent compared to the hotels I had stayed at before. All the staff were friendly, and their attention to detail, even in small matters, stood out.
area: District 1,Ho Chi Minh City - View on map

name: Roseland Sweet Hotel
detail: The location is great, a late-night taxi costs 270k (due to traffic jams from the ASEAN Cup victory, Grab prices increased), during the day, a taxi to the airport costs 70-100k. Major attractions, food, and shopping are all within walking distance. Next door is the famous Lyn Cherry, 50 meters away. I took a stroll around Japanese Street, but it wasn't particularly stunning. The room combines Japanese and Vietnamese styles, with a bathtub, but it's not as compact and well-equipped as a Japanese one; soaking in the bath every day is very comfortable. The breakfast is average, but the restaurant staff are very attentive and detail-oriented, proactively bringing spoons and chopsticks, and delivering rice noodles and coffee directly to the table. After checking out, Wy was very enthusiastic in helping with the luggage to the car. It is recommended to place the card for electricity retrieval in the room; otherwise, it takes a long time to cool down each time you return. The toilet paper and facial tissues could be upgraded as they are somewhat cheap.

name: Grandma Lu's Saigon Signature
detail: The room design meets my needs, the self-check-in and checkout service makes me feel comfortable, and besides the room, the spaces like the bathroom and toilet are clean as well. I will come back again if I have the chance.
area: District 1,Ho Chi Minh City - View on map

name: The Signature Boutique Hotel Saigon
detail: I stayed here for 2 nights and overall I am quite satisfied. The room is clean, just like the pictures, and the bed is comfortable, so I slept very well. Duy, the receptionist, is friendly, assists with check-in quickly, and is always enthusiastic when needed. The hotel location is also convenient, close to many restaurants and easy to move to attractions. If I have the chance to come back to this area, I would still choose to stay here.
area: District 3,Ho Chi Minh City - View on map

name: Rex Hotel Saigon
detail: It is located at the center of the tourist area and convenient for travel as it is at the entrance of the Opera House subway station. Although it's an old hotel, it has good hygiene standards and spacious rooms, and the beds are comfortable, allowing for a restful sleep. The room faced inward, so there was no city view, but being oriented to the south allowed plenty of sunlight to come in, which was nice. The lobby with luxury shops is also a comfortable place to take a break. It is particularly enjoyable to have music at the live bar with the free coupon. Breakfast includes various foods, but I especially liked the delicious kimchi. Since it is an older facility, I used a shower filter, and a bit of rust water came out. I recommend using the filter.
area: District 1,Ho Chi Minh City - View on map

name: PureJoy Hotel Saigon
detail: I’m a tourist visiting Vietnam, and I stayed here for just one night before continuing my trip. Honestly, I was completely surprised by how amazing this hotel is. Almost everything was absolutely lovely, from the room to the staff. The room was very clean, the furniture and facilities felt brand new, and the bathroom had excellent water pressure with both hot and cold water. The lobby is also beautiful and very tastefully designed. You can really tell that the person who designed this place has a great eye for aesthetics. Even though I only stayed for one night, the staff were incredibly friendly, helpful, and genuinely kind from the moment I checked in until I checked out. I honestly couldn’t find a single thing to complain about. I chose this hotel mainly because it’s conveniently located near Bui Vien Street and surrounded by plenty of restaurants and places to eat. But what really impressed me was how comfortable and satisfied I felt throughout my stay. I will definitely come back and stay here again many more times. And of course, I’ll be recommending this hotel to my friends as well! Absolutely loved my stay here! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
area: District 1,Ho Chi Minh City - View on map

name: LA VELA SAIGON HOTEL
detail: A perfect score just for the pool view. # Pros 1) The check-in was friendly from the start. I still remember the very kind staff with their full smiles. 2) The pool view is insane. I haven't seen a hotel pool with as good a view as this one in Ho Chi Minh City. The pool is also quite large, so you can enjoy it without bumping into people. 3) The city view from the balcony in the room was also nice. 4) The breakfast was very delicious, and I tried the dinner buffet, which was expensive but very tasty. 5) The location is very good. No need to discuss the details since you'll be taking Grab anywhere; everything is close. Even the airport can be reached within 30 minutes. 6) I had to leave early on the last day before breakfast time, and although it was meal preparation time, they allowed me to eat what was ready when I inquired. If it's a very early time, I would suggest requesting a packed meal, but if it's around 30 minutes, it's recommended to ask! # Cons 1) The accommodation is small. It's perfect for one person but can feel cramped for two. 2) Everything from the decor to the furniture feels old. 3) The carpeted floor felt dusty. 4) There are always many people at the pool, so there was rarely a spot available for sunbeds whenever I went. Of course, the pool is large enough for swimming without any issues, but if you want to lie down, you need to be diligent. It's usually occupied by Westerners, but there were always bar seats available. 5) It seems like events are often held by the pool. On the day I visited, there was a wedding, so half of the pool was not available. If you're staying for the pool, it's best to check this beforehand. # Conclusion If the price is not a burden, just go for it! If the price is a concern, consider how important the pool view is to you; that’s the key thing to think about!
